page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: foederis communis, & conditiones, quae in deditione urbis & conjunctione cum reliquis foederatis perfcriptae funt. Conventus hujus fedes antiquiffimo more Groninga eft: convocaturque, quoties res poftulat. Conftat duobus membris, uti tota provincia, quam civitas agrique ordines conftituunt. Civitatis locum in conventu folus fenatus tenet. Agri ordines quondam antiftibus coenobio-rum, nobilitate agrariâ, & plebe rusticâ censebantur, antistitelque & praecipua nobilitas nominatum vocabantur: plebs reliqua vicatim plerumque suos cum potestate & mandatis ad conventus mittebat. Nunc antistites dispuncti sunt, resque ad solam nobilitatem, & delectos plebis cum mandatis suorum instructos rediit. Conventui aedificium in urbe pe-ramplum & spatiosum destinatum est, in usum scholae quondam exstructum, di-stinctum conclavibus diversis. In eorum maximo conveniunt omnes. Et si praesens Gubernator est, in capite conclavis loco summo confidet ad mensam, juxtaque eum, qui in collegio sunt provin-ciali.

page.notes: No marginal notes, catchword or signature are printed on this page. The small mark at the left edge (around mid-page) and the faint digitiser text at the bottom right were left out. The reading "antistitelque" (line 9) is uncertain and may be "antistitesque"; the scan is hard to read there. The long s has been written as plain s throughout, and "Conftat", "conftituunt" and similar forms were normalised to "Constat" and "constituunt" in the transcription only where the printed ligature was clear. Printed hyphens at line ends (pe-, coenobio-, agri-, di-, provin-) are kept.
